schema.title: Product Details
schema.description: Shows how the description keyword renders as helper text under each field.

name.title: Product name
name.description: The public-facing name of the product. This is the first field users see.

sku.title: SKU
sku.description: A unique stock keeping unit. Optional—auto-generated if left blank.

price.title: Price
price.description: Price in USD. Supports two decimal places.

quantity.title: Initial stock
quantity.description: How many units to start with.

in_stock.title: Available for sale
in_stock.description: Toggle off to hide the product from the shop.

notes.title: Internal notes
notes.description: Only visible to staff. Supports multiple lines of text.

layout.description: If unchecked the product is hidden from the shop.
